mapper.sql: c.id,c.campus_id AS campusId,p.name AS campusName,c.academic_year_id AS academicYearId,y.name AS academicYear,c.grade,c.class_name AS className,c.capacity,c.status, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) FROM student_enrollment e WHERE e.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND e.class_id=c.id AND e.status='ENROLLED' AND e.ends_on IS NULL) AS studentCount, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(u.real_name,u.nickname,u.username) ORDER BY u.real_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM student_homeroom_assignment h JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=h.user_id AND u.tenant_id=h.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND h.class_id=c.id AND h.ends_on IS NULL) AS homeroomTeacher, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(u.real_name,u.nickname,u.username) ORDER BY u.real_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM school_class_teacher ct JOIN school_teacher t ON t.id=ct.teacher_id AND t.tenant_id=ct.tenant_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=t.user_id AND u.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE ct.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND ct.class_id=c.id AND ct.ends_on IS NULL) AS teachers
mapper.select: SELECT FROM school_class c JOIN school_campus p ON p.id=c.campus_id AND p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id JOIN school_academic_year y ON y.id=c.academic_year_id AND y.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (#{yearId} IS NULL OR c.academic_year_id=#{yearId}) AND (#{campusId} IS NULL OR c.campus_id=#{campusId}) ORDER BY p.name,c.grade,c.class_name

SELECT FROM school_class c JOIN school_campus p ON p.id=c.campus_id AND p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id JOIN school_academic_year y ON y.id=c.academic_year_id AND y.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (#{yearId} IS NULL OR c.academic_year_id=#{yearId}) AND (#{campusId} IS NULL OR c.campus_id=#{campusId}) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_campus_admin a WHERE a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND a.campus_id=c.campus_id AND a.user_id=#{userId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_homeroom_assignment h WHERE h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND h.class_id=c.id AND h.user_id=#{userId} AND h.ends_on IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_school_class_scope t WHERE t.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND t.class_id=c.id AND t.user_id=#{userId})) ORDER BY p.name,c.grade,c.class_name

SELECT FROM school_class c JOIN school_campus p ON p.id=c.campus_id AND p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id JOIN school_academic_year y ON y.id=c.academic_year_id AND y.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id=#{classId}

SELECT ct.id AS assignmentId,ct.teacher_id AS teacherId,t.user_id AS userId,COALESCE(u.real_name,u.nickname,u.username) AS teacherName,t.employee_no AS employeeNo,ct.subject_id AS subjectId,s.name AS subjectName,ct.assignment_type AS type,ct.starts_on AS startsOn,ct.ends_on AS endsOn FROM school_class_teacher ct JOIN school_teacher t ON t.id=ct.teacher_id AND t.tenant_id=ct.tenant_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=t.user_id AND u.tenant_id=t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN school_subject s ON s.id=ct.subject_id AND s.tenant_id=ct.tenant_id WHERE ct.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ct.class_id=#{classId} ORDER BY ct.ends_on IS NULL DESC,ct.starts_on DESC,ct.id DESC

SELECT t.id AS teacherId,t.employee_no AS employeeNo,t.title,t.status,u.id AS userId,u.username,u.real_name AS realName,u.nickname,u.phone FROM school_teacher t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=t.user_id AND u.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ENABLED' AND (#{search} IS NULL OR #{search}='' OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR t.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(u.real_name,u.nickname,u.username) LIMIT 30

SELECT u.id AS userId,u.username,u.real_name AS realName,u.nickname,u.phone,t.id AS teacherId,t.employee_no AS employeeNo,t.title FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN school_teacher t ON t.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND t.user_id=u.id AND t.status='ACTIVE' WHERE u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.status='ENABLED' AND u.user_type<>'SYSTEM' AND (#{search} IS NULL OR #{search}='' OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR t.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(u.real_name,u.nickname,u.username) LIMIT 30

mapper.select: SELECT sc.id,sc.exam_id AS examId,sc.student_id AS studentId,s.student_no AS studentNo,s.name AS studentName,sc.enrollment_id AS enrollmentId,sc.class_id AS classId,c.class_name AS className,sc.subject_id AS subjectId,su.name AS subjectName,sc.score,sc.absent,sc.remark FROM school_score sc JOIN student s ON s.id=sc.student_id AND s.tenant_id=sc.tenant_id JOIN school_class c ON c.id=sc.class_id AND c.tenant_id=sc.tenant_id JOIN school_subject su ON su.id=sc.subject_id AND su.tenant_id=sc.tenant_id WHERE sc.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sc.exam_id=#{examId} AND (#{classId} IS NULL OR sc.class_id=#{classId}) ORDER BY c.class_name,s.student_no,su.name
